svg.title: How Justless works
svg.desc: How Justless works: Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Gemini CLI, OpenCode, Copilot CLI, and Antigravity connect via hooks, MCP, or CLI to the local offline justless binary, which compacts commands (tests, lint, BuildKit, diffs, logs, tables, JSON), code (26 graph langs, 43 outline formats, map --explain, lookup --graph), and history (duplicates, semantic cues, compaction). Full output is archived locally in .justless/ and replayable byte-for-byte on demand via log, expand, and recall.
